classification_definitions.integration: Core observable assertion materially traverses genuine project service/API/network/process/store/runtime or production filesystem effect/readback.
classification_definitions.unit: Local validation/clock/concurrency/memory or synthetic dependency feed; incidental filesystem setup/prerequisite reads do not qualify a predicate.
classification_definitions.mixed: Separate material boundary assertions and independent local-only assertion blocks coexist.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Source/mapping/assertion reachability evidence cannot support a category; distinct from unknown runtime.

pipeline.boundary_and_limits: Actual upstream nats-server started on 127.0.0.1, random TCP port, JetStream temp store; nats.Connect(ClientURL). OpenStream creates a file-backed JetStream stream. publish sends bytes and GetMsg reads the acknowledged stored sequence. Follow uses ordered consumer, accepts verified windows into View. query synchronizes a streamed barrier and reads Handler over httptest loopback HTTP. Key/node verification is an in-memory predicate, not production registration. No regional deployment or broker-auth claim.

qualification_limits: SOURCE_ONLY_CANDIDATE. Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no compile/test pass/fail or runtime qualification claim.
All original assertions, replay/retention/gap/limit/normalization/schema/CLI/error obligations remain retained; no deletion, retirement, ledger/count or completion credit.

NATS fixture directly starts upstream server and connects using loopback TCP; this is not natscell.Start, production registration/authentication, clustering or regional serving. File-backed stream readback does not establish crash/power-loss durability.

HTTP handlers are genuine local httptest servers; key/node verifier is a fixture predicate. Window counter roots assert GetMsg stored readback; their auxiliary follower/HTTP startup is incidental and no acceptance of gru-1-ctl-1 is claimed.

Logscan subprocesses execute fixture shell commands and real bash/grep/cat; no live journal, vendor Fly, NetBird manager/SSH, OCI or Vault reached by these test paths. Run guard child branches return before such paths.
All20 baseline/current raw declarations are exact against survival; no canonical body drift.
No source-visible assertion contradiction identified in the manually inspected paths. This is not a compiler or comprehensive correctness audit.
